content:
Maya Patel: quick review — I pushed a compact invoke timeline + inline schema quick-insert prototype. need fast feedback.
Sam Kim: looks great. main worry: collapsed function defs feel hidden.
Maya Patel: thinking a pill `3 functions  edit` that expands. must support keyboard (Enter/Space) and aria-expanded.
Leo Huang: will add aria-controls and keyboard handlers. also Esc to close.
Olivia Ruiz: copy nit: use `functions` not `tools`. tooltip on truncation.
Priya Nair: a11y: color contrast low on light theme; bump to 4.5:1. add role=status for error toasts so screen readers announce mismatches.
Sam Kim: when tool-call fails from schema mismatch, show inline toast with `Tool call failed — schema mismatch. View suggested fix` linking to the editor.
playground-bot: prototype uploaded: https://playground.internal/r/compact-invoke-2026
Maya Patel: telemetry: add events quick-insert.open / quick-insert.insert / run-history.expand / schema.diff.view to measure discoverability.
Leo Huang: I'll draft telemetry PR.
Maya Patel: thanks — I'll update Figma and hand off to eng. :thumbsup:
